Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Punchline: A curated, searchable marketplace for Dalamud plugins.
Description: Omega by the Dalagab Group is a visual Dalamud plugin marketplace with Spotlight, Store-style Discover rich/fallback listings and product pages, standard plugin screenshots, Library/Collections, Updates with notifications, searchable tags and filters, explicit repository provenance, browser-opening project links, known-source selection, and install/uninstall lifecycle actions delegated to Dalamud over one hash-checked SQLite catalog built online.
